name: search-pages-and-databases
description: Searches the Notion pages and databases shared with the connection by title, most recently edited first, or lists them all with no query. Answers each result's object (page, or data_source for a database), id, title, url and last_edited_time, and a database's database_id. A page's id is what notion__get-page, notion__append-to-page, notion__update-page-properties, notion__add-comment and notion__create-page's parentPageId take; a data_source id is what notion__query-database and notion__create-page's dataSourceId take. nextCursor, or null at the end, is the startCursor of the next page.

query.description: Title words to search for. Omit or use an empty string to list everything shared with the integration.

filter.description: Optionally return only pages or only databases.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of results to return.

startCursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous search result.
